s.note: the academic decathlon trip to Washington
s.how: Pop 100g popping corn and toss with melted butter and salt. Mix with a few handfuls of pretzels. Slice 4 red apples and squeeze over a little lemon. Pack popcorn mix and apple slices into paper lunch bags, one per person, for the bus ride.

Layer 230g corn chips with 1 can drained black beans, 200g grated cheddar and 2 sliced jalapeños, twice over. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Top with 2 diced tomatoes, 150g sour cream and coriander, and serve straight from the dish.

m.note: Peter's order at Delmar's deli, pressed flat
m.how: Split 4 long bread rolls and spread with yellow mustard. Layer with salami, ham, provolone and sliced dill pickles. Press hard in a sandwich press or a heavy pan with a weight on top until flat, crisp and the cheese has melted. Cut in half to serve.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Pipe swirls of red and blue buttercream on top, then draw a little white icing web over each.

d.how: Spoon 2 tbsp chocolate syrup into the bottom of each tall glass. Add 100ml cold milk and stir well. Pour in cold soda water quickly while stirring so it foams up into a big white head. Drink straight away while it is fizzy.
